_comment: This is a TEMPLATE. Run src/utils/calibrate.py to generate the real file for your store.
_counting_region_help: OPTIONAL. The area that counts as your storefront. People whose feet fall outside it are ignored (e.g. someone across the street). Draw it with:  python -m visionmetrics.edge.tools.draw_zone --source 0 --config configs/store_config.json . Omit the block to count everywhere.
_far_line_help: OPTIONAL. A single (usually slanted) line of farness — two endpoints in normalised [0..1] image coords. Feet on the FAR side (away from the frame bottom) are ignored: not counted, not scored for engagement. Simpler than a polygon when you only need a depth cutoff. Draw it with:  python -m visionmetrics.edge.tools.draw_line --source 0 --config configs/store_config.json . Omit the block for no cutoff.
